verdict: clear: phone unified homepage caller, conservative grouped search projection and retained input/lifecycle safety
reviewed_behaviors: Default empty-query home uses all-VOD UnifiedCatalogBrowse; fixed family tabs route real metadata selections, while raw search still searches every eligible VOD without a browse category. Live/channel search and local history/favorites remain explicit entries.

Immutable snapshot-reference cache avoids repeated projection; grouped row anchors use stable work key rather than mutable primary source identity. Ordinary additions retain first/focused card key and offset; an explicit next window clears the previous viewport/pending snapshot.

Touch DOWN retains the actual bound original Video through deferred callbacks; canceled/slop/window/foreground guards remain, and previous representatives remain selectable only as known current-group alternatives.

Detail begins by pausing both catalogues, then reads the latest accepted group without rendering a hidden/touched grid. It preserves the clicked original source model while retaining newly accepted alternatives.
Known-source choices fetch the actual selected provider/id detail, preserve all alternatives, and validate foreground, detail ticket and chosen group before applying a delayed dialog selection.

Source/category/keyword/live transitions cancel or invalidate the corresponding prior page/detail request; paused, hidden or scrolling grids defer rendering; resume uses current handle and current tab.

Source declaration labels are distinguished from measured playback; existing player, API, registry, source picker and natural-order network/cursor/cancel helpers are byte-preserved outside the approved prior sorting substage.
scope_note: Independent review of CatalogActivity only. UnifiedCatalogPolicy/Browse were authored by this reviewer and are independently reviewed by root; their source paths intentionally do not appear in this approval.
